audit.method: Exact RGB signature of 30x30 metatile core; ignore only the 1-pixel interpolation halo whose colors depend on neighboring artwork.
audit.water_policy: Incidental water blocked; reviewed ice/glass/grass/stair floors are walkable.
audit.review_note: Primary and every retained secondary arrival visually checked on real floor with usable approaches; nearby obstacles and walking terrain reviewed in source/overlay context.
